title: Wine Portraits collection
description: The wines in the book: every wine logged in the cellar, and the wines you tried somewhere else. The book makes one page for each wine.

title.description: The book's title, shown on the cover and in the browser tab.

wines.description: Every wine logged in the cellar. A wine with no bottles left shows in the archive.

wild.description: Wine in the wild: wines you tried somewhere else. These have no quantity.

producer.description: Who made the wine, for example "Château Musar".

name.description: The wine's own name, for example "Rouge".

vintage.description: The year of the harvest. Use null, or leave it out, for a non-vintage wine.

region.description: Where the wine comes from, for example "Bekaa Valley".

grapes.description: The grape varieties, main grape first.

type.description: The style of wine. It also sets how dark the glass is in the drawing.

bottle.description: The bottle shape to draw. Pick the closest: "bordeaux" has straight sides and high, square shoulders. "burgundy" has a wider body and long, sloping shoulders. "champagne" is heavy, with sloping shoulders and foil over a wire cage. "flute" is tall and slim with a long, gentle taper. "port" has straight sides and a bulb in the neck.

quantity.description: Cellar wines only. The bottles you still have. At 0, the wine moves to the archive.

tasted.description: Wine in the wild only. When you tried it, for example "2026-09-20". A month ("2026-09") or a year also works.

where.description: Wine in the wild only. Where you tried it, for example a restaurant or a friend’s house.

window.description: The drinking window: [first year, last year].

place.description: Where it is made: the vineyards, soil and climate.

history.description: The story of the wine and its maker.

contents.description: What is in it and how it is made. The page shows the grapes first, then this text.

aromas.description: What you smell in the glass.

structure.description: Each level from 1 (low) to 5 (high). Leave out any that do not apply.

notes.description: Your own notes. The book shows them on the page after the wine’s page, with the line breaks you write.

sketch.description: Short notes in the margin, each with an arrow to a part of the bottle.
